name: YAHIVO – order updates to customers on WhatsApp

nodes.name: Order events from store
nodes.notes: Credential: Header Auth — Name: X-YAHIVO-Token, Value: <your N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET>. Put this webhook's Production URL in the store's N8N_WEBHOOK_URL.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', to: $json.to, type: 'template', template: { name: 'yahivo_order_update', language: { code: 'en' }, components: [{ type: 'body', parameters: [{ type: 'text', text: $json.firstName }, { type: 'text', text: $json.number }, { type: 'text', text: $json.text }] }] } }) }}

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp template
nodes.notes: Replace REPLACE_WITH_PHONE_NUMBER_ID (WhatsApp Manager → API setup). Credential: Header Auth — Name: Authorization, Value: Bearer <WhatsApp access token>.
